did: Server side of Game Week Bites, branches only. The first two slices, a drive ending at a kickoff and at the half and blocked punts and fake field goals read as big plays, had already merged in #1097 and #1101, so I closed them out with the evidence instead of rebuilding. I built catalog version 3, the claim algebra: eight measures, rank, league, team and trend shapes, deadlines and verdicts. Then home's weekly file for the Game Week essay: each ended NFL week's games, your bites, what home heard and the play each was matched to. Both were reviewed by a fresh session and pushed. I scoped the render job and filed it as server #1137, since it waits on the writer and the stage.

calls.title: A claim's sides are the direction of the number, not good or bad
options: Highest and lowest, above and below, rising and falling, with each measure saying which way is better
Best and worst, better and worse
calls.why: Going for it on fourth down is a style, neither good nor bad, so only directions give its claims sides that mean something.
calls.undo: Before any bite records catalog version 3, change the sides in crates/game_scenarios and dump version 3 again; after, a version 4.

calls.title: Challenges won waits for a later catalog
options: Ship eight measures and leave challenges won out
Ship all nine, reading challenges from ESPN's text
calls.why: The one recorded game holds a single challenge, too few to prove a reader of ESPN's challenge text on.
calls.undo: Add it to a version 4 once a reader is tested on real games.

calls.title: The week file lists only weeks that are ready
options: Leave a week out until its games are final and every bite is matched and heard
List every ended week with each bite's state
calls.why: The writer should never write from a week still moving, or decide that itself.
calls.undo: Change week_of in the server's mailbox/index/game_week.rs.

left: Home's render job for the Game Week essay, server #1137: it waits on the writer, the stage and their names from the phone side.
Both branches wait for the bucket PR: claude/gwb-catalog-v3 after the phone's claude/gwb-claims-catalog, and claude/gwb-week-file after the mailbox Worker's claude/gwb-week-index.
